original_question: Let Gamma be a numerical semigroup, let Frob(Gamma) denote its Frobenius number, let edim(Gamma) denote its embedding dimension, and let eta(Gamma) be the number of elements gamma in Gamma with gamma < Frob(Gamma). Is Wilf's inequality always true, namely Frob(Gamma) < edim(Gamma) * eta(Gamma)?
